mentions.name: Multi-agent harness IDE
mentions.description: This IDE is built around the author's workflow and supports multiple AI agent harnesses (e.g. Claude Code, Codex, pi, opencode), makes git worktrees much easier to work with, and includes its own code review workflow. It is used by the author's coworkers and friends and has increased their productivity compared to VS Code, Zed, or Cursor.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been building my own IDE that works the way do (and those in my social circles/professional life do). It allows for use of multiple agent harnesses (i.e claude code, codex, pi, opencode), and makes worktrees much easier to work with. Also has its own code review workflow.
mentions.author: jmvoodoo
